items.title: Add support for config_settings in requirements.txt / requirements.in
items.reason: Canonical match: astral-sh/uv#3636 tracks support for package-specific `--config-settings` in requirements files, including the same standalone-directive parse error. Maintainers confirmed the capability needs design.

items.title: Support flags in requirements.in for `uv pip compile`
items.reason: Exact prior report: inline `--config-settings` produced `Expected --hash`. A maintainer confirmed requirements files do not support it and redirected the report to astral-sh/uv#3636; it was closed as a duplicate.

items.title: Allow `--config-settings-package` to apply configuration settings at the package level
items.reason: Adjacent capability, not a requirements-file fix: astral-sh/uv#14573 added package-scoped configuration through uv's CLI/configuration, but did not add pip-compatible `--config-settings` parsing to requirements files.

related.search_scope: Searched open and closed issues plus open, closed, and merged pull requests for the exact `Expected --hash` and `Unexpected '-'` errors, `--config-settings` with `uv add` and requirements files, and conceptual terms covering per-requirement/package-scoped build-backend settings, requirements parsing, and pip compatibility. Fix-oriented searches inspected global CLI support in astral-sh/uv#1460 and astral-sh/uv#1833 and package-scoped support in astral-sh/uv#10940 and astral-sh/uv#14573; no pull request implementing requirements-file `--config-settings` support was found. astral-sh/uv#13834 and astral-sh/uv#4420 were ruled out as canonical matches because they concern `--no-binary`, which uv supports as a standalone requirements directive; splitting lines therefore does not transfer to unsupported `--config-settings`. astral-sh/uv#19360 concerns failures after using the separate package-scoped CLI option, not parsing requirements files.

type_reason: astral-sh/uv#3636 already tracks the same underlying missing capability: parsing per-requirement `--config-settings` from requirements files. astral-sh/uv#13375 demonstrates the identical error and was explicitly redirected there by a maintainer. The `uv add -r` entry point and clearer-error concern provide another reproduction and UX detail, but do not establish a regression because requirements-file support was never implemented.
summary: The report is a duplicate of open canonical issue astral-sh/uv#3636, corroborated by the exact prior duplicate astral-sh/uv#13375. Package-scoped settings were added separately by astral-sh/uv#14573, but requirements-file syntax remains unsupported.
